title: Work with us · Creosote Labs
meta_description: Creosote Labs is open to collaborations and takes on a small number of outside engagements each year.
intro:
We are open to collaborations, and we take on a small number of outside engagements each year. The ones that fit best overlap with work already under way here: operations systems, document tooling, teaching applications, and assessment-and-course engines for practitioners.

Tell us what you are working on, where it stands and what you would want from us. A few sentences are enough to start.
